config.reason: The v02 covert nomination candidate may reveal police through who nominates even when it avoids an explicit police claim. Freeze a targeted public-signal hunting counter before drawing a new sample.
config.seed_design: Distinct seeds are independent replicates; reuse the same 1024 seeds across all 12 fixed-policy arms for common-random-number paired comparisons. The seed interval is disjoint from preceding experiment intervals.
config.primary_outcome: Good faction wins at true game termination; never score a truncated rollout.
config.contrast_direction: Good win probability under signals minus under claims, holding the good policy and mafia bluff fixed; a negative delta favors the mafia counter.
config.interpretation: Exploratory targeted response to an identified candidate weakness, with a prospectively fixed fresh sample. Report every cell and contrast. No additional selection or fitted mixture; no unrestricted best-response, equilibrium, or GTO certificate.

intervals: Pointwise exploratory 95%; no multiplicity correction. Paired Wald plus conservative Hoeffding.
outcome: good faction terminal win, 0/1; no rollout truncation
raw_outcome_index: index i corresponds to seed_start + i in every cell
terminal_validation: play returns only at terminal; additionally assert binary winner and mandatory-death bound for every game

paired_contrasts.direction: signals minus claims in good win probability

paired.normal_interval_warning: Exploratory Wald interval; zero sample variance does not prove equality.
